title: MBCP L2 propagation pack (v0)
description: Cross-root tombstone propagation pack (RFC Q1/Q2), L4-attested (SPEC 1.2.6 Round B): the pack carries a deterministic ed25519 attestation_sig over the canonical bytes of {integrity, pack} (everything except the sig itself), produced by the SOURCE service root's per-root keypair; the pack body embeds the key_id fingerprint and attestation_pubkey so intake can verify the signature and authorize the source. Digest-chain integrity still runs underneath the signature layer; intake is additionally fail-closed against the destination root's authorized-source accept-list (SPEC 1.2.7).

attestation_sig.description: Deterministic ed25519 signature (hex128) over the canonical bytes of this artifact WITHOUT the attestation_sig field — binds the integrity block and the whole pack body (SPEC 1.2.6). Verified BEFORE the digest-chain gate at intake; missing or non-verifying signatures are typed rejects.

pack_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the object {"source_root": "...", "tombstone_digests": [<sorted digests>]} - binds the source root AND the tombstone set (SPEC 2 audit-7 tightening, 2026-11-08): same tombstone set from different roots = different packs, different ack paths.

key_id.description: Short fingerprint of attestation_pubkey (SHA-256[:16]) — the reserved key-rotation anchor and the lookup key in the destination root's authorized-source accept-list (SPEC 1.2.7). Must match the embedded pubkey.

attestation_pubkey.description: ed25519 public key of the SOURCE service root, embedded so intake can verify attestation_sig from the artifact alone (SPEC 1.2.6) and match it against the accept-list (SPEC 1.2.7).
